name: 33133 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33133 (Miami) has 251 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33133 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33133 (Miami) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
